paper.title: PRP-Graph: Pairwise Ranking Prompting to LLMs with Graph Aggregation for Effective Text Re-ranking

preparation.script: scripts/prepare_prp_graph.py (isolated venv: Python 3.10, pyserini 0.22.1 + Anserini 0.22.1 fatjar on OpenJDK 11.0.32, transformers 4.33.1, sentencepiece 0.2.2, langid 1.1.6; setup commands in the script docstring)
preparation.first_stage: Exact replica of PRP-Graph retriever/pyserini_retriever.py: LuceneSearcher.from_prebuilt_index('beir-v1.0.0-trec-covid.flat'), set_bm25() defaults (k1=0.9, b=0.4), topics 'beir-v1.0.0-trec-covid-test' field 'title', k=100, passage = ' '.join(('Title: ' + title + ' Content: ' + text).split())
preparation.truncation: Paper (rankers/rank_flan.py) truncates the query to 32 and each passage to 128 Flan-T5 tokens (google/flan-t5-large tokenizer). Frozen rule: the ORIGINAL-text prefix ending at the last byte of token 32/128 (SentencePiece piece offsets); the paper instead decodes the kept tokens, which differs only by NFKC normalisation in 15 of 4,433 passages. Offsets are frozen as passage_chars per doc.

beir_trec_covid.role: passage texts are rebuilt from corpus.jsonl by the adapter (verified against frozen SHA-256); queries/qrels used for cross-checks

topics_and_qrels.repo: https://github.com/castorini/eval (formerly castorini/anserini-tools; Anserini 0.22.1's cloud URL for these files is dead, so they were fetched at a pinned commit and placed in Anserini's cache)

castorini/rank_llm_data retrieve_results.result: identical top-100 docids in identical order for 50/50 topics

licence.documents: CORD-19 COVID Dataset License Agreement (AI2): 'license to use and make derivatives of the Data for text and data mining only', copyright stays with the publishers; no redistribution grant. Document texts are therefore not stored: the data/frozen files that scripts/prepare_prp_graph.py writes hold docids, truncation offsets and SHA-256 only, and the adapter rebuilds passages from the BEIR download.
licence.topics_qrels: TREC-COVID topics and relevance judgments (NIST), publicly redistributed by BEIR (Hugging Face card BeIR/trec-covid: cc-by-sa-4.0) and Anserini/pyserini; scripts/prepare_prp_graph.py writes them in full to data/frozen/prp_graph/trec_covid/queries.jsonl.
licence.beir_packaging: BEIR README: datasets redistributed as-is; users responsible for the underlying licences.

data/frozen/prp_graph/trec_covid/queries.content: 50 lines in BM25 retrieval order (pyserini topic-map order; this order seeds the paper's CV split): qid, query, query_input (32-token truncation), candidates [docid, BM25 rank, BM25 score] after the English filter, excluded_non_english, qrels (all judged docs)

data/frozen/prp_graph/trec_covid/passage.content: 4,433 lines: docid, content_chars, content_sha256, passage_chars, passage_sha256, passage_tokens_total, truncated

counts.qrels_note: pyserini qrels (used by the paper's trec_eval) = BEIR test.tsv minus two judgments labelled -1 (38/9hbib8b3, 50/svo94kuo); no effect on nDCG
counts.jev_requests_note: all ordered pairs per topic, sum n(n-1) over topics (495,000 without the English filter); total state JSON 596,431,136 chars (mean 1,229), questions 383 chars/request, request body max 2,065 chars
counts.prp_graph_pairs_actually_used_per_topic: R10 ~486, R20 ~961, R40 ~1,875 unordered pairs (x2 ordered requests), cf. paper Table 4 #Inference 489.1 / 965.5 / 1843.2

verification.english_only: Queries: all 50 TREC-COVID topics read, all English (langid flags topic 3 'fr' at 0.61: false positive). Passages (exactly the text Jev sees): segment-level langid 1.1.6 on title variants and abstract sentences, non-Latin-script detection and accented-word listing flagged 165 of 4,479 docs; every flagged passage read. 46 docs contain non-English text (non-English title, translated title variant, non-English abstract, or CJK journal name) and are removed from the candidate lists (list with reasons: NON_ENGLISH in scripts/prepare_prp_graph.py); 119 flags were English text with foreign proper names, loanwords, symbols or mojibake and are kept.
verification.port_vs_released_code: swiss_system: rankings, scores and comparison records identical to rankers/swiss_system.py for 150/150 (topic, R) with random pairwise scores; pagerank_aggregate: max |diff| 1.4e-17 vs rankers/pagerank.py + networkx 3.1, identical order 150/150

deviations: English-only rule: 46 non-English documents (49 topic-doc pairs) removed from the BM25 top-100 lists; topics keep 95-100 candidates. BM25 on the filtered lists scores 0.5975 vs 0.5947 unfiltered.

Truncation keeps the paper's token budget (32/128 Flan-T5 tokens) but cuts the original text instead of decoding tokens (15 passages differ from the paper's decoded strings, by NFKC normalisation only).
Jev's 'Passage A' probability is normalised over the two options; the paper uses Flan-T5's full-vocabulary softmax probability of the token 'A'.
All ordered pairs are requested (Allpair set); PRP-Graph's adaptive comparisons are replayed from them in predict(). Identical to adaptive querying under deterministic Jev answers.
One prompt (PRP-Graph rank_flan.py wording) is used for PRP-Graph and the Allpair baseline; the paper's baseline code quotes passages (Passage A: "...").

Primary metric is un-interpolated nDCG@10 (no test-label tuning). The paper's Table 2 per-dataset numbers are BM25-interpolated with alpha picked by 10-fold CV over the test queries; that protocol is reproduced only as a secondary, flagged number.
